P0_vanilla.technique: Textbook PINN: MLP on the raw contract inputs plus a put flag; Heston basket PDE residual in spots, variances and tau on the training box; soft payoff loss; Adam

P1_reduced.technique: Exact reduction: forward log-moneyness z, forward shares, the variances, tau and the Heston parameters and correlations; driftless PDE; put-call parity; far z boundary at the Levy base

P2_hard_payoff.technique: Hard terminal condition: c = Levy + tau * N(z, s, v, sqrt(tau), parameters) with Levy at the expected integrated variances, so the payoff holds exactly and the network learns the correction

P3_time_balanced.technique: Loss balancing: residual weighted by tau / tau_max against the 1/sqrt(tau) blow-up at the strike, with collocation tau = tau_max u^2

P4_variance_boundary.technique: Variance boundary (the one-stock Heston P4): the PDE residual with one stock's variance at v = 0, where it degenerates, and c_v = 0 with one stock's variance at v_hi = 1.5; collocation packed near v = 0 (v = v_hi u^2) and sqrt(v + 0.01) as the network input

P5_adaptive.technique: Residual-based adaptive sampling (RAD): every 1000 steps keep 32,768 of 131,072 candidates drawn with probability proportional to |residual| / mean + 1

P6_lbfgs.technique: Quasi-Newton polish: full-batch L-BFGS (strong Wolfe line search) warm-started from P5 on 16,384 RAD-selected collocation points

P9_envelope.technique: Enveloped correction: c = Levy + tau * phi(d_2) * N, which fades like the time value away from the strike; trained from a fresh start through the Adam and L-BFGS stages

P10_anchored.technique: Anchored (hybrid) PINN, as in the 1D study: fine-tune P9 with the PDE residual plus simulated prices at 4,096 anchor contracts of the training domain (their own seed), then L-BFGS

P11_permutation.technique: Stock-permutation augmentation: every anchor draw is presented under a random relabelling of the stocks (shares, variances, Heston parameters and both correlations moved together), under which the price is unchanged; otherwise as P10, fine-tuned from P9
